name: Universiteitstheater, Nieuwe Doelenstraat 16
surveyedSource: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012180412 ring (RD, PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) in native east/south metres above the 3DBAG ground (scripts/landmarks/universiteitstheater-footprints.json, written by venue-prepare.ts). The Amstel front and the Nieuwe Doelenstraat front are drawn from rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0, venue-face-crops.ts at 40 px/m: TMX7316010203-000354_pano_0001_001508, TMX7316010203-001975_pano_0000_001282, TMX7316010203-000717_pano_0000_000477, TMX7316010203-000224_pano_0000_000733, TMX7315120208-000073_pano_0003_000692); roofs and the walls over the De Jaren terrace keep the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0). attribution.title: Universiteitstheater, Nieuwe Doelenstraat 16, Amsterdam (University of Amsterdam)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for roofs and side walls (CC BY 4.0): the Amstel front with its white-banded ground floor, painted UNIVERSITEITS THEATER plinth, brick pilasters, festoon panels, modillioned cornice and balustrade, and the dark-brick Nieuwe Doelenstraat front with white-framed sashes, a stoop and the white entrance surround. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.

belowGroundEvidence: The Amstel front stands in the water: in the square-on panorama (TMX7316010203-000354_pano_0001_001508) the white plinth rises from the waterline 1.6 m below the stone course, and with the crop scaled so the cornice meets the 3DBAG roofs (11.3-12.5 m) the waterline falls at -1.75 m, the game's canal water (ownGround WATER_Z -1.77). The plinth with its painted UNIVERSITEITS THEATER lettering continues down to it instead of hanging over the water.
